slice: CAP-038 operator console for authenticated synthesis receipts

checks.inline_javascript_syntax: passed through the focused console test

compose_profile_render.command: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.worker.yml --profile PROFILE config --services
compose_profile_render.result: 12/12 expected isolated worker services rendered using non-secret required-variable placeholders

behavior: The console shows synthesis receipt creation only to operators with an exact-location ai_summary:draft grant.
The selectable task/type/service/profile pairs match the Gateway receipt registry and read-only Compose worker services.

Each selected Compose worker exposes only its own source database URL and worker credential variables (plus non-secret runtime settings); it has no shared runtime database password or another task's credentials.
An uncertain request reuses its non-secret idempotency UUID from tab-scoped session storage after reload; confirmed results and definitive client errors clear it.
A successful response must match the request, location, task, summary type, and authorized status before a manual worker command is displayed.
The displayed command loads local SOPS secrets, runs the selected isolated Compose profile, and passes the stable request receipt to the worker CLI.
The request route itself does not launch a worker; dispatch occurs only when the operator runs the displayed command.
limitations: Automatic dispatch, provisioned worker credentials, live OIDC, populated output parity, and MAN-CAP-038 acceptance remain open.
